subject: Biannual goals: hand-off & sensitive manager notes
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Biannual goals: hand-off & sensitive manager notes

Hi Marcus and Tessa,

I'm starting the formal hand-off for Priya's direct reports ahead of her transition next month. Attached is my draft of the biannual manager notes for the team (Q3_biannual_notes_grace.pdf) and an initial OKR roll-forward worksheet. Two things I need from you this week:  

- Marcus: can you review the manager notes and confirm you're comfortable owning the FY26 Q4 roll-forward for the two ICs on Priya's pod? There are two sensitive items flagged under "Performance Observations" that we should keep in the HR folder only.
- Tessa: can you confirm escalation coverage for support tickets during the first two weeks of the transition?

Proposed timeline: review by Tue 9/15, finalize redactions with HR by 9/16, share hand-off brief with the team on 9/20.

Attachments: Q3_biannual_notes_grace.pdf (manager notes - contains sensitive lines), OKR-rollforward-2026.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

Thanks,
Grace
Grace O'Connor
Director, Product Platforms
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>

Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Biannual goals: hand-off & sensitive manager notes

Grace,

Thanks — I can take ownership of the roll-forward. Quick notes after a skim:  

- I agree the two lines under "Performance Observations" need to be excluded from any team-facing materials. We should keep the full notes in HR-only storage.
- Can you mark the sensitive paragraphs with [HR ONLY] in the doc so I don't accidentally forward them?
- On coverage: I'll pick up primary on-call for the first week, Tessa can be backup.

If Neha can confirm the redaction process, I'll start migrating the OKR tasks into my tracker and propose new owners by 9/16.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Engineering Manager, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

Hi all,

Thanks for flagging this. A few HR items to make the hand-off compliant and low-risk:  

- Please do NOT share the full manager notes in a channel or with any non-participants. Keep the draft in the HR drive (I've included the drive link below).
- Grace: please annotate the sensitive paragraphs with the tag [HR ONLY] as Marcus suggested. That helps when we generate the redacted PDF for the team-facing brief.
- I'll create a private HR folder and move Q3_biannual_notes_grace.pdf there. I'll also produce a redacted version for the public hand-off.
- For documentation/audit: forward the final redacted PDF to me and mark it as "HR finalized" in the subject line.

Attachments: None (I'll copy the file into HR folder)
Links: HR folder — https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C_example_shared_notes

Neha Kapoor
People Partner
Redwood Inference

Thanks, everyone. Quick update and actions:  

1) I've added [HR ONLY] markers to the two sensitive paragraphs in the notes and uploaded the original to the HR folder. Neha — please move the file to the secure HR folder and create the redacted copy.
2) Marcus — thank you for stepping in. Please import the OKR-rollforward-2026.xlsx into your tracker and drop proposed owners by end of day 9/16.
3) Tessa — confirmed: primary coverage week one Marcus; Tessa backup. Please make sure the rotation is on the on-call calendar.

I'll prepare a short team-facing hand-off (no sensitive commentary) once Neha confirms the redaction. Targeting 9/20 for the team note and a private sync with Priya's reports on 9/21.

Best,
Grace

Attachments: OKR-rollforward-2026.xlsx
